The '''BII Butler Droid''', also known as a '''B-Two Butler''', was a type of [[Butler droid/Legends|droid]] used by the [[Treen family]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Haydnat Treen]], was serviced in her [[Haydnat Treen's apartments|apartments]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the BII Butler Droid named [[Wyx]], who had served her family for generations and was in a condition to continue serving them for at least several more [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]. Treen was satisfied with Wyx's services, which included taking her [[Clothing/Legends|coat]] upon entering her apartments and preparing baths for her, and trusted the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] security; nevertheless, the senator also instructed the butler to clear his databanks of sensitive information while she was involved in a [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracy]].<ref name="Ascension" />
